scope: Chromium frontend tests using local catalog/CMS API fixtures; no real checkout/database run

tests.title: home renders a live catalog, new images and working collection filters
collection recovers from a failed request and stale replies cannot replace the chosen filter
motion can be paused, persists across reload, and follows reduced-motion settings
mobile home and both auth modes fit without yellow panels or hidden controls
ThreeUI renders locally, animates and does not block shopping links
turning motion off removes the renderer and keeps the preference on reload
offscreen and hidden pages release the frame and recreate it when visible
reduced motion skips the effect download; live preference changes remove it
unavailable decorative source leaves the catalog and navigation usable
mobile resizes the canvas without horizontal overflow or focusable decoration
